international.title: ‘Difficult geopolitical times’: Albanese defends Bowen after Cop31 deal failure
international.summary: Coalition calls for climate change minister to resign immediately or be sacked over ‘catastrophic diplomatic disaster’, despite offering no alternatives on reducing emissions Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here Anthony Albanese has defended Chris Bowen from criticism following the failure of the UN Cop31 climate summit, blaming the result on “difficult geopolitical times” as the Coalition called for the minister to resign. Bowen served as president of negotiations at the talks in Turkey, helping run the conference with his Turkish counterpart, Murat Kurum. Continue reading...
